status: The beginning of an analysis. Nothing on this page is reproduced yet: every number is the authors' own, as reported.

paper.title: Back to basics: Observed statistics are sufficient to predict drug responses
paper.authors: Svensson, Khan, Heydari, Ubas, Thomas, Merico, Goodarzi, Yu, Alidoust, Gandhi
paper.reading: The PDF could not be retrieved in this pass (bioRxiv rate limiting); methods were read from the authors' own repository file autoresearch/paper_methods.md, their README and code.

reported.source: Rhaister README.md and CLAUDE.md at commit 75fed20 (means over splits)

plan.title: Reproduce it on the authors' data
plan.what: First our own short implementation of the delta view (the additive fit plus the drug-combination ridge) on Tahoe split 5_holdout, against the additive baseline; then the official pipeline on all five Tahoe splits and all six metrics; then the four Replogle–Nadig splits.
plan.data: 1.0 GB to start (Tahoe expression deltas and split files); 40.6 GB and 36 GB for the full pipelines

plan.title: How many measured perturbations does a new context need?
plan.what: The authors' drug titration (a panel of 1, 3, 6, 10, 20, 30 or 60 drugs, scored on one fixed test set) on Tahoe, and the same curve on Replogle–Nadig by shrinking each held-out line's panel.

plan.title: How many complete reference contexts are needed?
plan.what: The authors' cell-line titration on Tahoe (nested sets of reference lines). Replogle–Nadig has only three references per split, which is part of the answer.

plan.title: Does COMPASS predict what Rhaister can predict?
plan.what: Per knockdown, our COMPASS strength β against Rhaister's per-knockdown Pearson Δ on the Replogle–Nadig splits. Hypothesis: knockdowns dominated by the typical response are predicted well; those dominated by their own part are not.

plan.title: A well-artefact control
plan.what: Score the predictor on Tahoe's no-drug-well differences treated as drugs, and against half-sample ceilings we build from the raw data, since the release lacks the authors' A/B halves.
plan.data: local raw Tahoe (already on this machine)

plan.title: MegaFin
plan.what: Contexts are cell types and perturbations are drug wells: hold out part of the drug panel in some cell types, predict it, and compare with the ceiling MiniFin's replicate wells set. Then work out the panel and reference design the next MegaFin would need.
